description: Supports safe catalog browsing, request lookup, request creation, approval handling, hyperlink generation, and redacted user responses.
connectedAgentUsageDescription: Use for catalog browsing, request lookup, request status, request creation, approval handling, and user-scoped ServiceNow request support. Do not use for incidents or non-request tasks.
